ambiguity_list.kind: assumes knowledge the runbook does not give
ambiguity_list.what: It names 8 env vars and says they must be '与部署环境一致', but never says WHERE the staging values live, nor names the Railway project / environment / service. The linked r2-bucket-token-rotation.md covers MINTING new tokens, not reading the ones already deployed.
ambiguity_list.what_i_had_to_do: Discover on my own that they are Railway staging service variables, and that the project is b5d13d78-5d9b-4791-a6ae-7a7bc85f5d3d, env staging, service web. Nothing in the runbook points there.
ambiguity_list.blocking: Yes — without outside knowledge the walk cannot start.

ambiguity_list.severity: HIGH (for a drill), N/A (for a real incident)
ambiguity_list.what: The runbook begins from '内容桶丢了某个对象时'. It has no step, tool or guard rails for CAUSING the loss. MEDIA-A3 is a drill, so the blind operator must invent a delete — the single most dangerous action in the whole exercise — with zero guidance on which bucket, which key, or what to check first.
ambiguity_list.what_i_had_to_do: Write my own scaffolding (scratchpad only, not committed) with four guards the runbook never asked for: bucket name must equal fikirtive-staging; bucket name must not match /backup|production/; the backup copy must HEAD-exist before the delete; sizes must match.
ambiguity_list.blocking: Yes for a drill — and the danger is asymmetric: an operator who improvises this against the wrong bucket destroys the only copy.

ambiguity_list.what: '依赖：@aws-sdk/client-s3 与 @fikirtive/core（脚本从 packages/storage 的 package.json 起解析，仓库 pnpm install 过就行）'. That is false. @fikirtive/core's package exports point at ./dist, so a fresh checkout that has only run pnpm install fails with a raw MODULE_NOT_FOUND stack trace naming a path (packages/storage/node_modules/@fikirtive/core/dist/index.js) that gives no hint about the fix.
ambiguity_list.what_i_had_to_do: Recognise the workspace-build convention and run `pnpm --filter @fikirtive/core build`. A non-engineer would be stopped dead here.
ambiguity_list.blocking: Yes — reproduced verbatim at 09:48:01Z, step 3 of the log.

ambiguity_list.location: 第 1 步 · 定位对象键, first bullet
ambiguity_list.kind: names a table and a column that do not exist
ambiguity_list.what: '数据库：Asset / AssetVariant 一类表里该产物记录的 key 字段'. There is no AssetVariant model in packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma (grep count 0), and Asset has NO `key` column — it has ownerId, contentHash and ext, from which the key must be COMPOSED as u/<ownerId>/<contentHash>.<ext>.
ambiguity_list.what_i_had_to_do: Recover it from the key shape the runbook does state and from packages/core/src/storage-key.ts storageKey(). Recoverable, but the sentence sends you hunting for a column that is not there.
ambiguity_list.blocking: No — recoverable from the same paragraph's key shape.

ambiguity_list.location: 第 2 步, the three-check list
ambiguity_list.kind: claim the tool cannot honour in the order given
ambiguity_list.what: Step 2 says the dry-run verifies three things, the third being '备份桶里是否真的有这份副本'. In the script the content-bucket gate fires FIRST and throws, so while the object is still alive the command can never tell you whether a backup copy exists. In a drill that means: you must delete before you can check the copy is there — the exact order you do not want.
ambiguity_list.what_i_had_to_do: Use the backfill diff (mentioned only later, and its pre-delete role only in an HTML comment at the very bottom of the file) as the pre-delete safety check, plus my own HEAD of the backup bucket inside the delete scaffolding.
ambiguity_list.blocking: No, but it inverts the safety order for anyone rehearsing.

ambiguity_list.what: '拿这一行去访问 /files/<key>（产物页面的同一条路径）确认页面能重新打开'. That route is auth-gated: unauthenticated it answers HTTP 307 -> /login. The runbook never says you must be signed in as the owning merchant, gives no staging host, and offers no alternative (no signed URL, no CLI HEAD).
ambiguity_list.what_i_had_to_do: Substitute a HEAD through the runbook's own tool (the gate-2 'already exists' refusal) plus a direct S3 HEAD comparing size/ETag/ContentType. The literal instruction was not executable.

ambiguity_list.location: 第 5 步 + 演练记录 table
ambiguity_list.what: Step 5 orders two separate numbers ('RTO 只统计脚本自身…不含人工排查时间——两段分开报') but the 演练记录 table has exactly one 实测 RTO column and no column for the human-investigation segment, so the second number has nowhere to land. The HTML comment also says 执行者 = 'GitHub 用户名或姓名', while the only existing row is filled in as 'agent（Founder 授权…）' — an agent walker has no documented convention.

ambiguity_list.kind: footgun, correctly documented but badly shaped
ambiguity_list.what: The staging drill requires typing I_UNDERSTAND_THIS_TOUCHES_PROD=yes. The runbook explains why (the lock is credential-blind), so it is not ambiguous — but it trains the operator's fingers to type a production acknowledgement during a staging rehearsal, and there is no environment echo in the restore script's output to catch a mistake (the backfill script does print its bucket names; media-restore-object.mjs prints the backup bucket only, and only after the gates pass).

ambiguity_list.kind: doctrine the runbook cannot deliver on
ambiguity_list.what: It states that agents and drill scripts use '最小权限的只读/演练桶令牌' and never the write token. For a restore drill nothing issues such a token, and no procedure exists to get one, so the only way to complete the walk is with the deployment's read-write staging credentials — strictly more power than the drill needs (the restore path needs backup-READ + content-WRITE; the doctrine paragraph is written for the replication path's backup-WRITE + content-READ).
ambiguity_list.blocking: No — but the stated doctrine and the executable procedure disagree.

ambiguity_list.what: The restore writes back the BACKUP object's ContentType, not the DB's Asset.mime. For this object those differ in the fixture data (R2 image/png vs Asset.mime image/jpeg); the restore preserved R2's image/png, i.e. it round-tripped exactly. Worth one sentence so a future operator does not read the mismatch as damage.

Replace '仓库 pnpm install 过就行' with '仓库 `pnpm install` 之后还要 `pnpm --filter @fikirtive/core build`——@fikirtive/core 的 exports 指向 dist/，没 build 过脚本会报 MODULE_NOT_FOUND 且不提示原因。' A one-line pre-flight (`node -e "require('node:module').createRequire('packages/storage/package.json').resolve('@fikirtive/core')"`) would be even better.

recommended_runbook_wording_fixes.fix: Add a short '演练怎么造这个损失' section: pick the SMALLEST object of a test merchant (never a founder/real-merchant object); confirm the backfill diff is zero; HEAD the backup copy and match its size; then delete exactly one key from the CONTENT bucket, asserting the bucket name equals the staging content bucket and contains neither 'backup' nor 'production'; HEAD the backup again afterwards to prove it was not touched. State plainly that the delete is drill scaffolding and must never be run against production.

Correct the three-check list to say the gates fire in order and the content-bucket gate short-circuits: '对象还活着时这条命令只会告诉你「已存在」，不会验副本——演练前要确认副本在不在，用下面的差集命令（差集为 0 即全部有副本）。' And promote the daily-diff/pre-delete-diff instruction out of the bottom HTML comment into the visible body.

Replace the bare '/files/<key>' sentence with something a blind operator can run: name the staging host (https://web-staging-7901.up.railway.app), say the route is auth-gated and requires a session for the owning merchant, and give a credential-free fallback as the primary check — e.g. 'rerun 第 2 步的 dry-run：这次它应当报 already exists（内容桶 HeadObject 命中），那就是对象回来了；想看页面再用商家账号登录后访问 /files/<key>。'

recommended_runbook_wording_fixes.section: 第 5 步 + 演练记录 table
recommended_runbook_wording_fixes.fix: Add a second column '人工排查耗时' next to '实测 RTO' so the two mandated numbers both have a home, and change the HTML comment's 执行者 guidance to allow 'agent + 授权出处' since that is what both drills so far recorded.

Have media-restore-object.mjs echo the content and backup bucket names on its FIRST line the way media-backup-backfill.mjs already does, and add one runbook sentence telling the operator to read that line back before typing --apply. Cheapest possible guard against an environment mix-up given the prod-shaped interlock name.

Replace 'Asset / AssetVariant 一类表里该产物记录的 key 字段' with the truth: 'Asset 表没有 key 列——key 要拼：u/<ownerId>/<contentHash>.<ext>，三段分别取 Asset.ownerId / Asset.contentHash / Asset.ext（拼法的权威是 packages/core 的 storageKey）。' Drop AssetVariant, which does not exist.

Either mint and document a restore-drill token (backup-READ + content-WRITE, staging only) and point at it, or say explicitly that the restore drill uses the staging deployment credentials and why that is accepted — today the paragraph promises a least-privilege token that does not exist, which is the kind of 'written but nobody can follow it' gap the Founder's 修根不修表 ruling targets.
One sentence: '写回时用的是备份对象自己的 ContentType，不是 DB 里 Asset.mime——两者若不一致（存量数据里有），恢复保留的是备份桶那一份，属正常。'
